TrailShop team rules (ASP.NET Core, EF Core). Replace or extend with your Session 5 team rules.
- Every controller or action must declare [Authorize] (with a policy or role where needed) or [AllowAnonymous].
- Order, quote and customer data endpoints must check that the caller owns the resource.
- SQL must never be built from strings. FromSqlRaw/ExecuteSqlRaw with concatenated or pre-built strings is a finding.
- Html.Raw on data that a user or admin can write is a finding.
- Logging headers, emails, addresses, tokens or connection strings is a finding.
